## Type of change

- [ ] Method change (`SKILL.md`, `references/`)

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py . --strict` passes
- [ ] New pointers resolve on disk
- [ ] No personal data, credentials or absolute local paths
- [ ] No composite score, price target or guarantee
- [ ] If the method changed: lens matrix, workpaper matrix and methodology docs updated
- [ ] If the output changed: a template or example updated
